meta.title: Refactor asset conversion/management: Move to CLI tool and enable direct WAD loading
meta.body_summary: Refactor OpenKeeper's asset conversion into a standalone CLI tool and enable direct WAD file loading to eliminate startup conversion delays and reduce disk usage.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot large refactor with narrative perf claims; zero review/comments, closed after ~25 days without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 771 changed lines across 6 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume, introducing a new CLI tool, asset locator, and documentation. The PR was closed without merge, likely due to lack of reviewer engagement or unresolved scope concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR comment text is available in the dataset; the PR was closed after ~25 days with no maintainer feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster game startup by removing asset conversion from startup, enabling direct WAD loading, and eliminating duplicate .j3o model files.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by Trass3r without comment after 25 days; no review or discussion occurred.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale structural refactor involving multiple system components (CLI tool, asset loading, build config) was generated by Copilot but received zero maintainer review and was eventually closed. The agent produced a substantial change set, but the collaboration process broke down, and the PR was not merged.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-reading review in dataset; review was requested but no review text recorded.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or concrete before/after performance measurements; only narrative claims about instant startup and disk usage reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed by maintainer without comment or follow-up; no fix-in-PR cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored asset conversion into a standalone CLI tool (AssetConverterCLI.java), added direct WAD file loading (WadAssetLocator.java), modified ConvertModels to drop .j3o generation, updated Main.java to remove startup conversion, and added a Gradle build task for asset conversion.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: build.gradle adds the assetConverterCLI task; ConvertModels changes model export; doc file describes the refactoring details.
change_trajectory: Copilot added AssetConverterCLI, WadAssetLocator, modified ConvertModels and Main.java in second commit.
Third commit added documentation and a minor Main.java update; no subsequent changes.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with comprehensive refactor linked to issue #486; review was requested, but no reviewer engaged.
PR remained open without any comments or reviews for ~25 days.
Maintainer (Trass3r) closed the PR without comment.
